get.description: Get the current user's shopping cart with all items. Items are grouped by supplier to show how checkout will split orders. Each cart item includes baseUnitPrice/baseTotalPrice (before offer) and unitPrice/totalPrice (after offer when applied) for displaying price changes.

200.description: Cart retrieved successfully. Items include baseUnitPrice, baseTotalPrice (before offer), unitPrice, totalPrice (after offer), appliedOfferId.

items.description: All cart items (flat array). Each has baseUnitPrice, baseTotalPrice, unitPrice, totalPrice, appliedOfferId.

itemsBySupplier.description: Items grouped by supplier (matches checkout behavior)

itemCount.description: Number of items from this supplier

delete.description: Remove all items from the shopping cart

post.description: Add a product to the shopping cart. The system auto-selects the best offer (lowest total) for this product. If product already in cart, quantity is added and offers re-evaluated. Bundle offers require all bundle products in cart. Response includes baseUnitPrice/baseTotalPrice (before offer) for displaying price changes.

product_id.description: Product ID to add to cart

200.description: Item added. Returns full cart with baseUnitPrice, baseTotalPrice, unitPrice, totalPrice, appliedOfferId per item.

put.description: Update quantity or notes. Offers are automatically re-evaluated when quantity changes. Best offer (lowest total) is selected. For bundle offers, eligibility depends on other cart items.

delete.description: Remove item from cart. **Important**: Re-evaluates offers for ALL remaining items (bundle eligibility may change when a product is removed).

get.summary: Get available offers for cart item
get.description: Get all offers applicable to this cart item. Considers current quantity and other cart items (for bundle offers). Bundle offers require ALL products in the offer to be in cart with required quantities. Returns each offer with unitPrice, totalPrice, savings, savingsPercentage. Sorted by total price (best first).

unitPrice.description: Unit price if this offer applied

totalPrice.description: Total price if this offer applied

post.summary: Apply specific offer to cart item
post.description: Manually apply a specific offer. Overrides auto-selected best offer. Offer must be for this product and quantity requirement must be met. For bundle offers, all bundle products must be in cart. Returns cart item with baseUnitPrice, baseTotalPrice, unitPrice, totalPrice.

offer_id.description: ID of the offer to apply

post.summary: Remove applied offer from cart item
post.description: Remove manual offer and revert to auto-selected best offer (or base price if none). Recalculates best offer for this product based on current quantity and cart state.

Convert cart to orders. Uses cart item unitPrice/totalPrice (offer-adjusted) for order creation. Multi-supplier cart splits into multiple orders (one per supplier). Atomic transaction. Cart cleared after success.

200.description: Orders created successfully. Returns array of orders if multiple suppliers, single order if one supplier.

message.example: Cart checked out. Multiple orders created for different suppliers.

200.description: Order created successfully for the specified supplier.

order.description: Order object with buyerCompany, supplierCompany, and items.product relationships

get.description: Aggregated analytics for the dashboard home page, shaped by role. **Suppliers** (and supplier salesmen) get KPI cards (pending orders, active shipments, total products, total orders with trend), a daily sales series, best-selling products, and top buyers. **Buyers** (pharmacies and salesman buyer companies) get purchase analytics: KPIs (total orders with trend, pending orders, active shipments, total spend), a daily spend series, top suppliers by spend, and most-purchased products. Revenue/spend-based metrics only count fulfilled (delivered) orders. Suppliers see metrics scoped to their own company; admins see global metrics or a single supplier via `supplier_company_id`. Drivers are forbidden.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of trailing days for the sales overview series

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of rows for top products and top buyers

parameters.name: supplier_company_id
parameters.description: Admin only. Scope metrics to a single supplier company.

kpis.description: KPI cards. `trend` is present only for metrics with a period-over-period comparison; `trend.tone` is one of positive/warning/danger.

salesSeries.description: Number of fulfilled (delivered) orders per day for the trailing `days` window, oldest first, zero-filled. `date` is an ISO date (Y-m-d).

spendSeries.description: **Buyer payload only** — daily spend across delivered orders for the trailing `days` window, oldest first, zero-filled.

topSuppliers.description: **Buyer payload only** — suppliers ranked by total spent on delivered orders.

get.description: Get a driver's region plan: the plan type (fixed or daily), holiday weekdays, and either the fixed regions covered every day or the per-weekday schedule.

post.description: Assign regions to a driver as a fixed plan (covered every day). This replaces all existing region assignments and sets the plan type to fixed. Prefer POST /drivers/{driver}/region-plan for daily plans. Only suppliers can assign regions to their own drivers.

Set a driver's region plan. For a `fixed` plan provide `region_ids` (one or more regions covered every day). For a `daily` plan provide `schedule`, a map of weekday to region id (one region per weekday). Weekdays marked as the driver's holidays cannot be assigned a region. Replaces any existing assignment. Only suppliers can manage their own drivers.

region_ids.description: Required for a fixed plan. Regions covered every day.

schedule.description: Required for a daily plan. Map of weekday (saturday..friday) to region id.

put.description: Set the weekdays a driver is off. A holiday weekday cannot be assigned a region in a daily plan; any region already assigned to a newly added holiday weekday is removed automatically. Pass an empty array to clear all holidays. Only suppliers can manage their own drivers.

delete.description: Remove a specific region from a driver. Only suppliers can remove regions from their own drivers.

post.description: Create a new order for a **single supplier**. Only buyers and salesmen can create orders. Prices are always resolved server-side by PricingService based on buyer type, supplier classification, quantity (wholesale eligibility), and custom price lists — client-supplied unit prices are ignored. **Important:** This endpoint creates ONE order for ONE supplier. If you need to order from multiple suppliers, use the cart checkout endpoint (`POST /cart/checkout`) which automatically splits the cart into multiple orders (one per supplier).

supplier_company_id.description: Supplier company ID - all items must belong to this supplier

items.description: Array of order items. All products must belong to the specified supplier_company_id

201.description: Order created successfully. Returns a single order object. For multi-supplier orders, use cart checkout which returns an array of orders.

order.description: Single order object with buyerCompany, supplierCompany, and items.product relationships

get.description: Get details of a specific order. **Multi-supplier context:** Each order represents a transaction between ONE buyer and ONE supplier. If a buyer checked out a cart with items from multiple suppliers, they will have multiple separate orders (one per supplier). This endpoint returns details for a single order, including buyerCompany, supplierCompany, creator, items.product, statusLogs.user, and driver (if assigned).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Order ID

200.description: Order retrieved successfully. Includes all relationships and driver information if assigned. The order represents a single supplier-buyer transaction.

order.description: Order object with buyerCompany (buyer info), supplierCompany (supplier info), creator, items.product, statusLogs.user, and driver relationships

post.description: Transition order to a new status. Valid transitions are enforced. **Multi-supplier context:** Each order is managed independently. If a buyer has multiple orders from different suppliers, each order's status must be updated separately. Suppliers can update status for orders placed with them, buyers can view status updates.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Order ID

status.description: New order status. Must be a valid transition from current status.

notes.description: Optional notes about the status change

200.description: Order status updated successfully. Returns updated order with buyerCompany, supplierCompany, and items.product relationships.

post.description: Cancel an order. Requires cancellation reason. **Multi-supplier context:** Each order can be cancelled independently. If a buyer has multiple orders from different suppliers and wants to cancel all, each order must be cancelled separately. Stock is automatically reverted when an order is cancelled.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Order ID

200.description: Order cancelled successfully. Stock has been automatically reverted. Returns updated order with cancellation_reason.

order.description: Cancelled order object with status set to cancelled and cancellation_reason populated

post.description: Queue an async export of orders (CSV or JSON) for one company. The response is **202 Accepted** with the export record (status `queued`) — poll `GET /orders/exports/{id}` until status is `completed`, then download via `GET /orders/exports/{id}/download`. Users export their own company's orders; admins may pass `company_id` to target any company. Optional filters: `status`, `date_from`, `date_to`.

get.description: Poll this endpoint while an export is queued/processing. Once `status` is `completed`, download via `/orders/exports/{id}/download`.

post.description: Apply up to 200 stock operations in one call (in / out / adjustment / return per row). Each row is processed independently through StockMovementService — authorization and stock rules are enforced per product; a failed row does not roll back the others. Rows may carry `batch_number`/`expiry_date`, which also update the product's current batch. **Route note:** registered before the products resource so `{product}` cannot capture it.

200.description: Bulk operations processed. Returns one result per row with success/failure details.

post.description: Move stock from this product to another company's product atomically: an `out` movement on the source and a cross-referenced `in` movement on the destination (which inherits the source's current batch/expiry). Admin only.

to_product_id.description: Destination product (must belong to a different supplier company)

CartItem.description: Cart item with product, pricing, and optional applied offer

unitPrice.description: Current unit price (after offer if applied)

totalPrice.description: Current total (quantity × unitPrice, after offer if applied)

baseUnitPrice.description: Product base price before any offer (for showing strikethrough/original price)

baseTotalPrice.description: Base total before offer (quantity × baseUnitPrice). When offer applied, use to show savings.

appliedOffer.description: Offer object when an offer is applied

quantityFree.description: For buy_x_get_y: free items per qualifying set

Error.title: Error envelope
Error.description: Standardized error body returned by EVERY failed request. `error.title` is a short, status-derived label and `error.message` is a human-readable explanation safe to show end users. `errors` is present only on 422 validation failures (absent for business-rule 422s).

errors.description: Field-keyed validation messages. Present only on 422 validation responses.

quantity: The quantity must be at least 1.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication required — the bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but not permitted to perform this action (role, company scope, or policy).

error.title: Forbidden
error.message: You do not have permission to perform this action.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist, or is not visible to the authenticated company.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Input validation failed (then `errors` is present) OR a business rule was violated (e.g. insufficient stock, credit limit exceeded, empty cart — `errors` is absent).

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded. Retry after the period given in the Retry-After response header.

error.title: Too many requests
error.message: Too many requests. Please slow down.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state — typically the resource already exists (duplicate buyer-supplier relationship, price-list entry, or client assignment).

sanctum.description: Enter your bearer token in the format: Bearer {token}

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Platform analytics (admin only): system-wide statistics, order trends and driver performance.

tags.name: Buyer-Supplier Relationships
tags.description: Manage buyer-supplier partnerships, payment terms, and credit limits. Suppliers can create relationships with buyers, set credit terms, and track outstanding balances.

tags.name: Cart
tags.description: Shopping cart management. **Offer system**: Each cart item can have one offer applied. The system auto-selects the best offer (lowest total price) per product. Offer types: buy_x_get_y, percentage_discount, fixed_discount, bundle_percentage, bundle_fixed. Bundle offers require ALL products in the offer to be in cart with required quantities. Cart items include baseUnitPrice/baseTotalPrice (before offer) for displaying price changes.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Aggregated analytics for the dashboard home page

tags.name: Enums
tags.description: System enums and constants. Use for dropdowns, validation, and form options.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: In-app notifications (order status changes, low-stock alerts). Notifications belong to the authenticated user; mail copies are sent automatically.

tags.name: Offers
tags.description: Product offers and promotions. **Offer types**: buy_x_get_y (buy X get Y free), percentage_discount, fixed_discount, bundle_percentage (bundle with % off), bundle_fixed (bundle with fixed off). All offers require quantity_required. Bundle offers require multiple products. Applied in cart via CartOfferService (best offer auto-selected per product).

tags.name: Order Exports
tags.description: Async order exports (CSV/JSON). Exports are queued, scoped to a single company, and downloaded once completed.

tags.name: Order Templates
tags.description: Reusable order templates per buyer company. Templates are shared between the company's users; reorder places fresh orders at current server-resolved prices.

tags.name: Price Lists
tags.description: Custom per-buyer pricing management. Suppliers can set negotiated prices for specific buyers and products. Custom prices have the highest priority in the pricing resolution engine (above wholesale and retail tiers).

tags.name: Reviews
tags.description: Verified-purchase reviews for products and suppliers. One review per user per target; admin-moderated.

tags.name: Salesmen
tags.description: Salesman management: listing, region assignment, client (pharmacy) management, and on-behalf ordering. Supplier-associated salesmen belong to a supplier company. Independent salesmen have their own buyer company.

tags.name: Search
tags.description: Cross-entity autocomplete suggestions for search bars.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Admin user management: list, create, inspect, update (role/company/password reset), and deactivate accounts.

tags.name: Wishlist
tags.description: Per-user product wishlist. Items can be moved to the cart at current server-resolved prices.
